jobs.title: Lead Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About this role:**

Wells Fargo is seeking a **Lead Product Manager** within the Commercial Bank to serve as a Product Owner responsible for driving execution of strategic product initiatives and delivering customer and business value through agile product teams. This role will partner closely with Product Managers, Technology Leaders, Architects, Operations, Risk, and business stakeholders to translate strategic priorities into actionable product capabilities, ensuring successful delivery of solutions that meet customer needs, regulatory requirements, and operational objectives.

**In this role, you will:**

* Lead one or more product teams in delivering business and customer value through execution of product initiatives aligned with established product strategies and roadmaps.
* Own and prioritize the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities, customer needs, risk requirements, and regulatory commitments.
* Collaborate with L2/L3 Product Managers and stakeholders to translate strategic objectives into actionable epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Drive backlog refinement, sprint planning, release planning, product reviews, and demonstrations to ensure effective execution and delivery.
* Partner with technology, architecture, operations, and business teams to define solutions and ensure successful implementation of product enhancements and capabilities.
* Facilitate prioritization decisions across competing demands while balancing customer value, operational efficiency, technical dependencies, and regulatory requirements.
* Manage cross-functional dependencies, identify delivery risks, remove impediments, and drive timely resolution of issues impacting product delivery.
* Validate business requirements and acceptance criteria to ensure delivered solutions meet customer expectations, quality standards, and business objectives.
* Monitor product area performance, user adoption, operational outcomes, and stakeholder feedback to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Support process automation, AI-enabled capabilities, and modernization initiatives that enhance customer experience and operational effectiveness.
* Collaborate with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Control partners to ensure solutions adhere to enterprise policies, governance frameworks, and regulatory requirements.
* Communicate product priorities, delivery progress, risks, and outcomes to stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Drive a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous learning, and Agile best practices across the product team.
* Provide guidance and mentorship to junior Product Owners and team members while promoting effective product management practices.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of Product Management, Product Ownership, Business Analysis, or equivalent experience.
* Experience leading Agile product delivery teams and managing backlogs within complex enterprise environments.
* Strong experience defining user stories, acceptance criteria, business requirements, and release planning activities.
* Experience working closely with engineers, architects, designers, and business stakeholders to deliver technology solutions.
* Proven ability to manage competing priorities, dependencies, risks, and delivery commitments across multiple workstreams.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Experience using Agile delivery tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to influence outcomes and drive execution in matrixed organizational environments.

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Experience in Commercial Banking, Supply Chain Finance, Lending, Receivables Finance, Treasury Management, Payments, or related banking domains.
* Experience supporting platform modernization, workflow automation, and digital transformation initiatives.
* Knowledge of banking regulatory, risk, and control frameworks.
* Experience with SQL, Power BI, data analytics, and reporting tools.
* Familiarity with AI, Generative AI, intelligent automation, and data-driven product decision making.
* Strong understanding of Agile, Scrum, Kanban, and modern product operating models.

**Posting End Date:**

19 Oct 2026

* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.***

**We Value Equal Opportunity**

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

Candidates applying to job openings posted in Canada: Applications for employment are encouraged from all qualified candidates, including women, persons with disabilities, aboriginal peoples and visible minorities. Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Product Technology Manager
jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 3 years of experience troubleshooting technical issues for internal/external partners or customers.
* Experience in either system design or reading code (e.g., Java, C++, Python).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master’s degree in Business, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering or Applied Science, or a related field.
* 5 years of experience managing projects and working with analytics, software coding, or customer-side web technologies.
* 5 years of experience with data analysis and SQL/MySQL.
* 5 years of experience working with Unix or Linux operating systems/commands.
* Ability to work with ambiguity, overcome complex challenges and scale effectively across a large organization and highly distributed team.
* Ability to navigate complex business organizations, manage multiple cross-functional stakeholders and consult optimal solutions.

**About the job**
-----------------

gTech Ads is responsible for all support and media and technical services for customers big and small across our entire Ad products stack. We help our customers get the most out of our Ad and Publisher products and guide them when they need help. We provide a range of services from enabling better self help and in-product support, to providing better support through interactions, setting up accounts and implementing ad campaigns, and providing media solutions for customers business and marketing needs and providing complex technical and measurement solutions along with consultative support for our large customers. These solutions range from bespoke and customized ones for our customers to scalable support for millions of customers worldwide. Based on the evolving needs of our ads customers, we partner with Sales, Product and Engineering teams within Google to develop better solutions, tools, and services to improve our products and enhance our client experience. As a cross-functional and global team, we ensure our customers get the best return on investment with Google and we remain a trusted partner.

  

Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. Whether the answer is a bespoke solution to solve a unique problem, or a new tool that can scale across Google, everything we do aims to ensure our customers benefit from the full potential of Google products.  
  
To learn more about gTech, check out our video.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Partner with internal stakeholders to establish technical roadmaps that accomplish our business objectives. Understand complex, ambiguous, open-ended business problems and produce results-oriented strategy to solve those problems.
* Build and action product architectures and solution roadmaps, including the design of infrastructure necessary to support the business objectives of our stakeholders.
* Create launch programs with partners to ensure that new products and feature releases are tested before broad-scale deployment. Perform implementation reviews, convert new product features and ensure the prompt and proper resolution of technical challenges.
* Ensure that technical solutions are designed in a way that enable other analytical teams to easily access data for operational reporting and data visualization.
* Collaborate with product engineers to enhance core platforms and create applications using standard and Google-specific software development tools.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Senior Product Compliance & Risk Manager - India
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money. Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money. For everyone, everywhere.

More about our mission and what we offer.

 **Job Description**

The Product Compliance & Risk (PC&R) team sits at the centre of Wise’s product development function, supporting our cross-functional teams to deliver exceptional compliant-by-design products for our customers.

We’re seeking a highly motivated, customer-centric individual to join our team to leverage their deep understanding of India regulatory requirements and expectations to launch new products, grow our presence and manage compliance risks in India.

This hands-on first line of defence (1LOD) role will involve working closely with product teams in APAC and globally to ensure our controls strike the right balance between meeting compliance requirements whilst maximising customer experience.

**This is a hands-on role, with high levels of ownership over:**

* Designing and continuously improving our products and controls: Leverage your deep understanding of the Wise product and regulatory requirements and risks to support new product launches. This includes communicating requirements in clear, practical terms, and taking a risk-based, scalable approach with the customer experience front-of-mind when designing, uplifting and implementing controls.
* Regulatory and financial crime risk management: Stay ahead of trends and the regulatory agenda in India, identify, assess and present risks quantitatively and qualitatively in clear and understandable terms, and work collaboratively to define and execute on risk mitigation plans.
* Regulatory change and remediation: Conduct regulatory gap analyses, define and scope actions to remediate gaps, and ensure implementation plans are executed in a timely manner. Collaborate with global teams to identify synergies with programs of work already completed or underway across the Wise Group, and ensure Wise Product teams are aware of the most recent regulations and guidance.
* External engagements: Represent Wise through external engagements such as audits and regulatory inspections, including explaining and defending our controls, and developing and executing remediation plans.

**This role will give you the opportunity to:**

* Grow your hands-on Fintech knowledge at full speed, with high levels of ownership and autonomy.
* Collaborate with our amazing teams both locally and globally to build state-of-the-art products for our customers that are compliant-by-design.
* Be empowered to identify problems and opportunities, and take a lead in the solution design and implementation.

**About you:**

* Expert in regulatory and financial crime compliance and risk management in India, with 10+ years experience in financial services (banking, fintech or consulting) and a deep understanding of the expectations of local regulators/policymakers.
* High levels of ownership and autonomy, with the ability to proactively identify improvement opportunities or areas of elevated risk, prioritise, and drive work from inception to completion at pace with limited oversight. This includes anticipating risks and roadblocks, and demonstrating resilience to work through them.
* Problem solving attitude, with the ability to not only analyse and interpret complex regulatory and risk management frameworks, but to exercise sound judgement in proposing and implementing customer-centric and scalable solutions, using data to drive decision-making and quantify risks.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to effectively interact with different audiences (from Product & Engineering teams to external auditors and regulators such as the RBI).
* Strong collaboration skills, to work effectively with different stakeholders globally (such as Product, Risk and Compliance), and to influence without authority.
* Challenge the status quo, thinking outside-the-box and questioning how we can achieve an optimal balance of achieving compliance whilst delivering the best outcomes for our customers.
* Previous experience working directly with product and engineering teams, including effectively translating regulations into actionable business requirements.
* Willingness to travel, as Wise offices are located across different countries.
* Legally authorised to work in India or Singapore.

**Nice to have but not essential:**

* Previous experience in working in a fintech or a similar fast-paced environment.
* Previous experience working with a PA-CB and/or ADII licensee.
* Experience working in cross-border teams.

 **Additional Information**

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.  
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.

Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

At Amazon Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce (WWRR), we aspire to zero: zero cost of returns, zero waste, and zero defects.  
  
We are an agile, innovative organization dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ to benefit our customers, company, and environment. True to Amazon’s tenets, customer and seller obsession are always at the forefront of our decisions. We are constantly innovating and design our services and tools with a focus on customer and seller experience; to create long-term value at Amazon by investing in the future and focusing on the planet, not just on the bottom line. WWRR includes business, product, program, operational, data, and software engineering teams, who together manage the lifecycle of returned and damaged products.  
  
We are looking for a skilled Product Manager to be a part of the Seller-Fulfilled Returns team. In this role, you will be working with product managers, software developers, program managers, and operational partners to improve the seller-fulfilled return experience. As a Product Manager, you will champion global Amazon processes, identify improvement opportunities, and drive the change management, testing, and content creation for new seller-fulfilled return products worldwide. The ideal candidate has strong business acumen, have the ability to communicate with stakeholders on multiple levels, demonstrate ownership, and will be comfortable with ambiguity while working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

------------------------

* 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with end to end product delivery
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience as a product manager or owner
* Experience owning technology products

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
* Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. * *Location; Hyderabad, India*
* *Job type: Full time*

*About Sanofi*

*At Sanofi, we're chasing the miracles of science to improve people's lives. We're an AI-driven biopharma company, leveraging cutting-edge technology and data to dramatically reduce the time from molecule discovery to delivering life-changing medicines to patients. Our ambition is bold: harness artificial intelligence, advanced analytics, and modern data platforms to revolutionize how we discover, develop, manufacture, and deliver healthcare solutions globally.*

*Our Team: Global Services & Experience – Devices Management*

*The Digital Workplace Services team is at the heart of Sanofi's employee experience and productivity. We design, deliver, and operate the foundational technology services that enable seamless work experiences for over 100,000 employees across 70+ countries. Our mission is to unlock value through intelligent service delivery, user-centric design, and world-class platform management.*

*We're responsible for core services and products that sustain employee productivity and day-to-day operations, covering Office (Multi-Functional Printers) ans M&S Printing Services (such as Zebra Printers, Label Printers, and Thermal Printers), print platform management, managed service vendor governance, and the technology roadmap that powers secure and efficient printing across Sanofi's global footprint. We don't just manage printers—we architect the future of how Sanofi employees print, scan, and share documents, ensuring every device, platform, and service interaction is optimized for performance, security, cost-efficiency, and sustainability.*

*Role Overview*

*As Global Delivery Manager for Printing Services, you will be a strategic leader and hands-on operational manager responsible for evolving Sanofi's global Office Printing Services into a secure, cost-optimized, and future-ready foundation. This is not a traditional printer support role—this is a strategic operational leadership position that bridges vendor governance, product ownership, financial management, platform oversight, and cross-functional stakeholder engagement.*

*You will own the end-to-end delivery of Office Printing Services globally, drive vendor performance excellence, and champion the transformation from reactive device support to intelligent, data-driven print operations. You'll work at the intersection of managed services, device lifecycle management, print platform management, and modern security frameworks, building partnerships with the global managed service provider and internal stakeholders to deliver world-class printing experiences across all Sanofi sites.*

* *Ensure the managed service provider adheres to Sanofi's security, compliance, data protection, and operational standards for all printing services*
* *Manage vendor relationship at a strategic level, fostering partnership and continuous improvement while maintaining accountability for service delivery*

***Budget Management & Financial Governance***

* *Develop annual budget forecasts in collaboration with Finance, tracking actuals vs. budget monthly and providing variance analysis and corrective action plans*
* *Optimize cost efficiency through vendor negotiations, consumption analysis, and identification of cost-saving opportunities (e.g., print policy optimization, device rationalization, etc.)*
* *Approve purchase orders, invoices, and financial commitments related to printing services within delegated authority*
* *Provide regular financial reporting to Digital leadership and Finance stakeholders, including cost per page, total cost of ownership (TCO), and ROI metrics*

***Service Quality & Operational Delivery***

### **Description and Requirements**

**Role Responsibility**
=======================

We are offering an exciting opportunity to contribute to MetLife’s digital and AI transformation journey. We are seeking an experienced **Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) for the Data domain** to ensure highly available, scalable, performant, and reliable data platforms, pipelines, and services. This role will drive operational excellence, strengthen observability, improve incident response, reduce toil through automation, and partner with engineering, data, cloud, and operations teams to enable resilient data services and measurable business outcomes.

**Core Responsibilities**
=========================

* **Data Platform Reliability:** Ensure the availability, performance, scalability, and reliability of data platforms, pipelines, and services through proactive monitoring, troubleshooting, and issue resolution.
* **Service Design and Implementation:** Collaborate with engineering teams to design, implement, and operate large-scale data systems, including software and tooling to automate and streamline operations.
* **Automation and Scripting:** Develop and maintain scripts, utilities, and automation tools to improve operational efficiency, reduce manual effort, minimize errors, and support repeatable data platform operations.
* **Monitoring and Alerting:** Design, implement, and continuously improve monitoring, alerting, dashboards, and observability signals to enable early detection and timely resolution of issues.
* **Collaboration and Communication:** Partner with engineering teams, product managers, data stakeholders, cloud teams, and operations teams to ensure services meet business requirements and align with company goals.
* **Incident Response and Management:** Participate in incident response, service restoration, root cause analysis, postmortems, and corrective actions to improve resiliency and prevent recurrence.
* **Documentation and Knowledge Sharing:** Maintain accurate documentation for systems, services, runbooks, processes, and operational procedures, and promote knowledge sharing across the team.
* **Governance and Day-to-Day Operations:** Support day-to-day data platform operations while ensuring alignment with internal standards, global governance requirements, operational controls, and production support processes.

**Skills and Experience**
=========================

* **Programming, Scripting, and Data Processing:** Hands-on experience with Python, Spark, Bash, and PowerShell for automation, diagnostics, data processing support, operational tooling, and repeatable platform operations.
* **Azure Data Platform:** Experience supporting Azure Data Lake Gen2, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics including Data Warehouse, Spark, and Pipelines, Azure SQL Database, Cosmos DB, and Databricks in production environments.
* **Observability and Monitoring:** Proficiency with Azure Application Insights, Azure Log Analytics, Azure Monitor, Splunk, AppDynamics, and ELK to monitor availability, performance, pipeline health, application behavior, logs, metrics, traces, and alerts.
* **DevOps and Source Control:** Working knowledge of Azure DevOps and GitHub Enterprise for repositories, CI/CD pipelines, release management, operational changes, branching strategies, and controlled production deployments.
* **Containers and Cloud-Native Operations:** Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) to support containerized workloads, platform reliability, deployment operations, scaling, and service health management.
* **ITSM and Operational Governance:** Experience using ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM platforms for incident, problem, change, request, and knowledge management in a governed enterprise environment.
* **SRE and Production Reliability:** Strong understanding of SLIs, SLOs, SLAs, error budgets, incident response, root cause analysis, postmortems, runbooks, automation, production readiness, and toil reduction practices.
* **Disaster Recovery & Resilience Engineering:** Design and architect for multi-region systems to meet strict RTO (Service Availability) and RPO (Data Integrity) targets. You will drive down RTO via automation (Terraform, auto-scaling, DNS failover) and enforce RPO through robust replication and Continuous Data Protection (CDP) strategies.
* **AI-Assisted Engineering:** Ability to use GitHub Copilot and Microsoft 365 Copilot responsibly to accelerate investigation, documentation, scripting, knowledge discovery, and operational productivity with appropriate human validation.
* **Collaboration and Execution:** Strong communication, documentation, troubleshooting, evidence capture, escalation management, and cross-functional collaboration skills across engineering, data, cloud, product, and operations teams.

**Minimum Qualifications**
==========================

* 4– 6 years in production support, DevOps, infrastructure, cloud operations, or software engineering.
* Experience supporting business-critical systems and working in incident, problem, and change management processes.
* Ability to script and automate standard operational tasks using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or equivalent.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Exposure to regulated enterprise, insurance, banking, or financial services environments preferred.
* Exposure to Hybrid cloud platforms including on-premises and Azure-hosted services.
* Business proficiency in English; Japanese language skills are a plus.

**Preferred Exposure**
======================

* Japanese language ability, including reading and writing.
* Domain knowledge of life insurance business processes, data platforms, and operational support needs.

jobs.title: Product Manager -II
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Microsoft Copilot is redefining the future of work by bringing the power of AI directly into your everyday tools. We are looking for a **Product Manager II** to join us on this mission to build a truly AI-first assistant that fits seamlessly into the workflows of our users. This is a high-impact role where you will shape the experience for millions of users using the Copilot app on their desktop devices, working at the intersection of AI, productivity, and mobile innovation.

We’re looking for a customer-focused Product Manager II to join us on this mission.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Starting January 26, 2026, Microsoft AI (MAI) employees who live within a 50- mile commute of a designated Microsoft office in the U.S. or 25-mile commute of a non-U.S., country-specific location are expected to work from the office at least four days per week. .
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
* 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc).
* 2 years of experience developing/launching products/technologies within one or more of the following: Cloud, SaaS, enterprise, internal tools, or supply chain networks.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with Quote-to-Cash, Ordering, Fulfillment or Supply Chain Product Management.
* Experience in Platform Product Management.
* Knowledge of Ordering and Fulfillment Processes and Systems for Hardware or Software.
* Strong product management, business acumen, investigative, and stakeholder management skills, with exceptional attention to detail.
* Strong problem solving, data analysis and business judgment skills.

**About The Job**
At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.
  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.
  
  
The OREO (Ordering, Entitlements and Obligations) team powers Google Cloud's commercial success by managing order booking and product fulfillment orchestration. Part of GCBP (Google Cloud Business Platform), we are modernizing the Quote-to-Cash life-cycle—from ordering and provisioning to billing—ensuring data quality across Cloud's financial, sales compensation, and transaction systems. We offer a collaborative, culture focused on major architectural upgrades and high-stakes initiatives.
  
  
As a team member, you will manage the migration to Cloud's automated booking and orchestration platform, launching new agreement types, products, and Go-To-Market (GTM) motions to reshape the post-agreement experience for customers and internal teams. We provide growth opportunities, empowering Product Managers to direct high-visibility programs and strategic integrations alongside talented peers. Join us to solve tests and impact Google Cloud's commerce platform.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead the product roadmap for core ordering systems, modernizing and automating Google Cloud's Quote-to-Cash life-cycle across offline and online flows.

**Company Description**
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
  
  
**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
  
  
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
  
  
**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
More about
**our mission**
and
**what we offer**
.
  
  
**About Wise**
Wise is building money without borders. Our customers should be able to move, hold, receive, and spend money internationally with a product that is fast, transparent, low-cost, and safe.
  
  
Verification is central to that mission. We need to keep financial crime out of Wise, meet regulatory obligations across many markets, and make it easy for legitimate customers to get started and use our products.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Global KYC and Onboarding Squad is improving Wise's KYC and onboarding experience by reducing three things at the same time:
  
  

* Financial crime risk, by making reviews, controls, and decisioning more effective.
* Operational cost, by automating repeatable work and improving how agents handle complex cases.
* Customer friction, by making verification clearer, faster, and easier to complete.

Business Onboarding Verification focuses on business customers. Businesses are not simple identity objects: they are legal entities connected to directors, shareholders, UBOs, authorised signatories, employees, documents, registry data, vendor data, ownership structures, risk signals, and market-specific requirements.
  
  
That makes KYB one of Wise's most complex verification domains. It is also one of the biggest opportunities to improve customer experience, reduce manual work, improve control quality, and build better risk decisioning.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are hiring a Product Manager to own one of the workstreams within Business Onboarding Verification. Each PM within the team owns a complex product area end to end, from discovery and roadmap through delivery, measurement, and iteration.
  
  
These are not generic AI, programme management, or stakeholder coordination roles. You will coordinate complex work, but the core of the job is product ownership: defining the problem, shaping the solution, making trade-offs explicit, setting success metrics, launching safely, and ensuring each change improves KYB as a product.
  
  
**What You Will Own**

* Own the product roadmap for one BOV workstream, from discovery through launch and iteration.

* Build feedback loops from agents, QA, assurance, customer outcomes, support contacts, downstream risk signals, and vendor/model performance where relevant.
* Balance tactical delivery with long-term product foundations.

**What Success Looks Like In The First 6-12 Months**

* Your workstream has a clear roadmap with explicit priorities and measurable outcomes.
* The team has shipped meaningful product improvements, not just analysis or coordination.
* Product changes are safer to launch because metrics, guardrails, monitoring, fallback paths, and ownership are clear.
* Cross-functional partners understand what is being solved, why it matters, who owns what, and how success will be measured.
* KYB becomes faster, more measurable, more auditable, and easier for legitimate businesses and agents to navigate.

**This Role Gives You The Opportunity To**

* Work on one of the most important regulated onboarding domains at Wise.
* Improve the experience for business customers and the agents reviewing their cases.
* Build practical AI, automation, decisioning, controls, and platform foundations in a real operational environment.

* Shape how Wise moves from fragmented manual review and tactical control work toward reusable, measurable KYB capabilities.

* Constructs and implements operational data store

* Adheres to data management standards and advises on best practices
* Participates in building and testing business continuity & disaster recovery procedures…

This opportunity also calls for strong problem-solving skills, ability to research solutions for technical challenges and continuous learning.

**Key responsibilities**

  

* Work with the Product Owner, Architects, Software developers and testers, and the Scrum Team to understand, define, and test solution requirements in both On Premise and Cloud environments
* Participate in Scrum meetings with other team members, including sprint planning and estimating; backlog refinement; daily Scrum meetings; sprint retrospectives, and sprint reviews
* Create, execute, and maintain automated test scripts using LUA in the internal automation framework.
* Understand functional requirements/user stories and translate them into effective automated test scenarios.
* Execute automated regression suites, analyse failures, and report defects with clear repro steps and evidence (logs/screenshots where applicable).
* Perform debugging/troubleshooting of test scripts and test environment issues; collaborate with developers, SMEs and other QAs in the team to resolve problems.
* Contribute to test data preparation and validation required for automation runs.
* Help maintain automation assets: reusable libraries, utilities, naming conventions, documentation, and best practices.
* Collaborate closely with developers, architects, and product owners to understand system behaviour and define testable acceptance criteria
* Perform root cause analysis on test failures and work with development teams to drive resolution
* Continuously evaluate and improve test coverage, reliability, and execution performance
* Contribute to defining QA best practices, standards, and processes within the team

**Required skills and experience**

  

* Working knowledge of LUA scripting (or strong scripting fundamentals with willingness to ramp up quickly in LUA).
* Understanding of software testing fundamentals: test cases, defect lifecycle, regression testing, and test coverage concepts.
* Familiarity with automation testing concepts (locators, assertions, waits/retries, data-driven testing, modular scripting, etc.).
* Basic understanding of Agile/Lean concepts; awareness of SAFe practices and terminology (PI, iteration/sprint, user stories, acceptance criteria).
* Proficiency in at least one automation-capable programming language, ideally C#, to maintain and improve custom frameworks, not just use off-the-shelf tools
* Familiarity with CI/CD integration - embedding automated integration test suites into pipelines (Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions)
* Experience with version control tools like Git (basic branching, commits, pull requests).
* Ability to write clear documentation and communicate test results effectively.

**Desired skills and competencies**

  

* Knowledge of AI tools and concepts, such as using AI assistants effectively, understanding “skills” (tool/function capabilities), and familiarity with custom AI agents.
* Familiarity with API testing concepts or tools

**R&D at AVEVA**

Our global team of 2000+ developers work on an incredibly diverse portfolio of over 75 industrial automation and engineering products, which cover everything from data management to 3D design. AI and cloud are at the centre of our strategy, and we have over 150 patents to our name.

Our track record of innovation is no fluke – it’s the result of a structured and deliberate focus on learning, collaboration and inclusivity. If you want to build applications that solve big problems, join us.

You’ll also be joining an award-winning workplace. AVEVA is Great Place to Work® Certified™ in multiple countries, reflecting the culture our people create every day. Explore our awards and recognition.

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/r-and-d-careers/

**India Benefits include:**

Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well-being support

It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/

* Flexibility to support delivery activities, including proofs of concept, effort estimation, project planning, risk identification, and executive-level presentations
* Showcase of strong stakeholder management skills to engage IBM i SMEs, application owners, business analysts, cloud architects, and technical leadership across client and internal organizations
* Qualifications in governance and compliance, ensuring adherence to enterprise architecture standards, security policies, data-protection controls, and regulatory obligations
* Proficiency in English at an Upper-Intermediate level (B2) or higher

Commenda is building the agent for global legal and tax work. Teams use it to register entities, manage obligations, and stay compliant globally. Today that work requires additional headcount, local vendors, and disconnected systems.

We’re hiring a Product Manager to turn complex legal, tax, and operational work into reliable, agentic products. You’ll define how agents use company context, interpret requirements, take action, and involve people when judgment or approval is needed. You’ll work directly with customers, engineers, domain experts, and operations to build products that deliver compliance outcomes.

You’ll report to the Head of Product and start as a generalist. Over time, you may specialize in Transfer Pricing, Indirect Tax, or Entity Management. You’ll own your product roadmap, aligning it with business priorities and the company-wide roadmap.

**What you’ll work on**
-----------------------

**Build agents that get compliance work done.** Define how agents move from understanding a customer’s situation to planning and executing work. You’ll specify the context and tools they need, the actions they can take, and when they should ask for clarification, request approval, or escalate to an expert.

**Make agent behavior measurable and reliable.** Work with domain experts to define what correct behavior looks like, build evaluation datasets, and assess performance across real scenarios and edge cases. You’ll use traces, customer feedback, and expert corrections to identify failures and create feedback loops that continuously improve the product.

**Turn regulatory complexity into product behavior.** Help translate written requirements across jurisdictions into structured rules that capture applicability, conditions, exceptions, deadlines, and dependencies. You’ll define requirements and validate behavior with experts so our agents can determine what a customer needs to do and drive the next steps.

**Build and improve workflows yourself.** Work alongside operations and subject matter experts to understand how tasks are performed, then build workflows using Commenda’s workflow builder. You’ll identify where agents can take over work, where human review adds value, and how to make the overall process faster and more reliable.

**Design how customers, service providers, and agents work together.** Our products support customers buying services from Commenda, working with third-party providers, and handling work in-house. You’ll define responsibilities, permissions, handoffs, approvals, and visibility so each participant knows what needs to happen and can trust the work being done.

**Talk to customers, prototype, and prioritize.** Lead product interviews and feedback sessions, use Claude Code or Codex to prototype user journeys, and test ideas before committing engineering effort. You’ll combine customer insight, product analytics, and evaluation results to make roadmap decisions and measure whether what we ship improves outcomes.

**What we’re looking for**
--------------------------

* **At least two years of product management experience**, with examples of products or workflows you’ve taken from an ambiguous problem through launch and iteration.
* **Hands-on experience with AI evaluations.** You’ve defined what good output or behavior looks like, evaluated results against that standard, and used failures to guide improvements. You understand that a compelling demo is only the beginning of building a reliable AI product.
* **Advanced proficiency with Claude Code or Codex.** These tools are part of how you work. You can independently build prototypes, explore product ideas, and test workflows. You don’t need to know how to code, but you need to communicate effectively with engineers and define precise requirements.
* **Strong judgment about agentic user experiences.** You can reason through what an agent should do autonomously, where people need control, and how users should understand progress, review work, and recover when something goes wrong.
* **Exceptional spoken and written English and a confident customer presence.** You can lead interviews, ask precise questions, explain complex ideas clearly, and earn customers’ trust.
* **Strong ownership and organizational skills.** You can coordinate work across engineering, internal and external domain experts, operations, and customer success, keep decisions and dependencies clear, and drive unresolved issues to completion.
* **A willingness to get into the details.** You’re comfortable learning how work actually happens, investigating edge cases, configuring workflows yourself, and validating results with experts.
* **Familiarity with Figma and product analytics tools such as Mixpanel.** You use prototypes and data to understand behavior, test assumptions, and make product decisions.
* **Curiosity and rigor in complex domains.** You’re interested in developing a working knowledge of legal, tax, and regulatory requirements, checking assumptions, and preserving the details that determine the right outcome.

Experience shipping a customer-facing AI or agentic product is a plus, as is experience with Braintrust or another AI evaluation and observability platform. A background in tax, accounting, entity management, or compliance is helpful but not required.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

About Amazon Business:  
Join Amazon Business, where we're revolutionizing B2B commerce. As a rapidly growing $50 billion global business, we're building a future where businesses of all sizes can find, discover, and purchase everything they need with unprecedented ease and intelligence. Our mission: to become the world's most customer-centric company and the preferred strategic partner for smart business buying. From solo entrepreneurs to Fortune 500 companies, we serve diverse business customers across eleven countries, reimagining procurement with innovative solutions that drive efficiency and growth.  
At Amazon Business, it's still Day 1. If you're passionate about solving complex challenges, creating disruptive solutions, and making history, this is your opportunity. Bring your insight, imagination, and healthy disregard for the impossible as we unlock the vast potential of B2B commerce in India.
  
  
The Role:  
Are you excited about building products that transform how millions of businesses discover and adopt e-commerce?  
Amazon Business India is looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the Shopping Experience and Marketing Tech charter for Amazon Business in India.  
  
The Vision: We believe the next frontier in B2B commerce is moving from generic experiences to deeply personalized ones. Unlike B2C, Amazon Business customers register with verified business identifiers (GST, PAN), giving us rich context — industry, company size, purchase patterns — from Day 1. We intend to leverage this unique B2B advantage to deliver smarter, more relevant experiences across every customer touchpoint, both onsite and offsite.  
  
We are seeking a talented Senior Product Manager to own the Shopping Experience and Marketing Tech charter for Amazon Business in India. This is a dual-mandate role spanning two interconnected domains:  
  
1. Onsite Shopping Experience: You will re-imagine every aspect of the business customer's onsite journey — browse, search, selection and offer discovery and checkout. The objective is to simplify the end-to-end shopping experience with personalization and friction reduction to increase frequency and basket size of business customer purchases. You will create a north-star experience that enables customers to quickly discover the most relevant product or high-value action, and complete their purchase with the fewest steps possible.  
  
2. Off-App Marketing Tech: You will own the marketing technology stack that powers automated, personalized outbound engagement across every customer touchpoint off-app, including:
  

* Organic & AI surfaces — traditional search (SEO) and emerging AI platforms
* Conversational surfaces — WhatsApp and chat-based engagement
* Outbound channels — email and push notifications
* Amazon.com and social — on-platform and social media surfaces

  
You will build and scale the systems and tooling that enable marketers to create, test, and optimize customer lifecycle journeys without engineering dependency — driving high-intent engagement back into the Amazon Business app and strengthening the brand across off-app surfaces.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
  

* Vision & Strategy: Define the long-term product vision and roadmap for both onsite shopping experience and off-app marketing tech — creating a unified engagement layer across all customer touchpoints
* Personalization: Drive the development of personalization capabilities that leverage business context and behavioral signals to deliver relevant experiences across onsite and offsite channels
* Customer Understanding: Develop deep understanding of business customer lifecycle patterns, procurement behaviors, and channel preferences to inform when, where, and how we engage customers
* Experience Design: Design and implement customer experiences that are contextual, frictionless, and consistent across the onsite journey and outbound channels
* Marketing Automation: Build and scale marketing automation systems that enable personalized, multi-channel customer journeys — from acquisition through retention — with self-serve tooling for marketing team
* Innovation: Pioneer new approaches to B2B customer engagement across emerging surfaces including AI platforms, conversational interfaces, and agentic experiences — positioning Amazon Business ahead of shifting customer behavior
* Metrics & Experimentation: Define success metrics, build a robust experimentation roadmap, and drive continuous optimization across all channels and lifecycle stages
* Collaboration: The roadmap will be a mix of India-first products and India adaptations of global product features. You will partner closely with senior stakeholders across engineering, science, marketing, UX design, and business intelligence teams across Amazon India and Amazon Worldwide

  
A day in the life  
You start your morning reviewing key product metrics and customer feedback, identifying signals that inform your next set of priorities. By mid-morning you are in a design review, debating trade-offs on a new feature with your engineering and design partners. After lunch you draft a product requirements document, pressure-testing assumptions with data from recent experiments. Later, you connect with cross-functional partners to align on an upcoming launch plan and resolve open dependencies.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of end to end product delivery experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with end to end product delivery
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience as a product manager or owner
* Experience owning technology products

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
* Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders

Managers – Investigations (RPE) set the direction and culture of their teams within a defined strategy by managing individual and team performance expectations and goals, providing individual coaching feedback sessions and weekly one-on-ones that focus on making Amazon's transportation platforms safer to transact, improving customer satisfaction, monitoring real-time service levels and schedule adherence, and serving as the point of contact for escalated investigation resolution of a supervisory nature.  
  
The incumbent manages a team of L2–L3 Investigation Specialists who conduct risk reviews on drivers and accounts to protect Amazon from fraud, abuse, and account takeover, and who take appropriate actions based on processes, tools, and high-judgment decisions. This is a direct-supervisory role over individual contributors; the incumbent does not manage managers, and the number of reports is determined by their manager.  
  
Operating in an area with established procedures and a predictable workflow, the incumbent provides tactical management, makes sound decisions within the team's defined strategy, and seeks direction and coaching from their manager as they continue to develop their management skills. Cross-Functional Coordination **Serve as the primary coordination and communication point across Engineering, QA, DevOps, Infrastructure, Product, and Business teams.**  Manage upstream and downstream dependencies to enable successful integrated releases. **Escalate blockers and risks impacting release timelines, testing activities, or environment availability.**  Facilitate regular governance meetings with technical leads, delivery leads, QA teams, and other stakeholders to review environment utilization, release schedules, and conflict resolution. Required Skills & Experience **Proven experience in Environment Management, Release Management, or Application Delivery Management within complex enterprise environments.**  Strong understanding of SDLC, release governance, change management, and deployment processes. **Experience managing multiple concurrent environments and coordinating cross functional teams.**  Knowledge of distributed architectures, microservices, middleware, integrations, and enterprise commerce platforms. **Experience working with DevOps, QA, Infrastructure, and Engineering teams in Agile delivery environments.**  Strong stakeholder management, communication, planning, and risk management skills. **Experience with change governance, CAB processes, incident management, and RCA coordination.**

jobs.description:
**PRODUCT MANAGER — HOTEL | FINKRAFT.AI**
  
Location: Bengaluru, HSR | Full-time | Level: L4 | Reports to: CPO / BU Head

**ABOUT FINKRAFT.AI**

Finkraft.ai is a B2B SaaS company that enables enterprises to maximise GST claims on travel and expense data. The platform automates invoice collection, validation, and reconciliation across airlines and hotels — helping finance teams at McKinsey, BCG, Capgemini, Abbott, and 1,250+ enterprises improve compliance, visibility, and cash recovery. We've recovered ₹300Cr+ in GST claims and are scaling from $1.5M to $10M ARR in 18 months.

The Hotel vertical is our primary growth unlock for the next 18 months. This PM owns it.

**THE PROBLEM YOU ARE SOLVING**

A corporate employee books a hotel through a TMC or GDS. The booking passes through a PMS like Opera Cloud. The invoice is generated by the hotel, sometimes routed through a Concur integration or a bank lodge card program. By the time the finance team tries to claim GST on that invoice, the corporate GSTIN is missing, the folio is incomplete, the tax breakdown is wrong, or the invoice never arrived.

This happens at scale across every enterprise client Finkraft serves. Your job is to understand every node in that chain — hotel, PMS, GDS, OTA, TMC, Concur, bank, payment player — and build the product that fixes it.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN IN 90 DAYS**

- Full ecosystem map completed: every player in the hotel invoicing and GST chain documented — where data breaks, who owns the fix, and what Finkraft's integration surface is at each node.
- Field engagement calendar live: structured visit schedule across TMCs, hotel chains, corporates, and software companies — minimum 15 discovery meetings completed, findings structured into roadmap inputs.
- One PRD shipped to engineering: based on field findings and existing client pain, a product spec written, reviewed, and in active development.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

Product Strategy and Roadmap

* Own the end-to-end product strategy for the Hotel vertical: what gets built, in what sequence, and why
* Define the roadmap based on enterprise client pain, ecosystem partner signals, and competitive landscape — not internal assumptions
* Present roadmap to leadership, Sales, and enterprise clients at QBRs; defend prioritisation decisions with data and customer evidence
* Track roadmap delivery against committed timelines; own the gap between what was promised and what shipped

Field Ecosystem Engagement

* Conduct structured field meetings across the full hotel ecosystem: TMCs (BCD, CWT, FCM, SOTC), GDS providers (Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport), OTAs (MakeMyTrip, Booking.com, Expedia), hotel chains and revenue management teams, PMS vendors (Opera Cloud, IDS, Hotelogix), corporate travel managers, expense platform teams (Concur, Happay, Zoho Expense), banks (for lodge card and virtual card programs), and payment platforms (Razorpay, HDFC SmartPay, Mastercard CEP)
* Extract structured product intelligence from every field meeting: integration documentation, data flow maps, GSTIN handling gaps, invoice format standards, and API availability
* Convert field findings into product inputs within 5 business days of every meeting — not raw notes, structured inputs

Ecosystem Integration Ownership

* Map data flow across the full chain: hotel PMS → GDS/OTA/TMC → Concur/expense tool → bank/payment → Finkraft → GST claim
* Identify where corporate GSTIN, folio data, and invoice tax breakdowns break at each handoff
* Define integration specifications for priority ecosystem partners; own the partner relationship through integration go-live
* Maintain a live integration roadmap: what's in production, what's in development, what's blocked and why

PRD and Engineering Partnership

* Write clear, complete PRDs for every feature in development: problem statement, user stories, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and success metrics
* Partner with engineering through the full build cycle — not just handoff and review
* Attend standups, unblock decisions in real time, and accept or reject releases based on defined criteria
* Maintain a product backlog that engineering can execute against without PM involvement in every sprint decision

Sales, BA, and CS Collaboration

* Feed qualified product intelligence to Sales: what integrations exist, what gaps remain, and what client use cases are unlocked by each roadmap item
* Work with Senior BAs on field observations — BA finds the problem, PM defines the fix
* Support enterprise client conversations on product capability, integration timelines, and roadmap commitments — own what you say in the room
* Partner with CS on rollout plans for new features: training, documentation, and client communication owned by PM, not CS

Market and Regulatory Intelligence

* Track GST regulatory changes relevant to hotel invoicing: e-invoicing thresholds, folio compliance requirements, GSTIN transmission mandates
* Monitor hotel-tech landscape: new PMS entrants, GDS API changes, OTA invoicing policy shifts, Concur integration updates
* Bring competitive signals into roadmap prioritisation — what are enterprise clients being offered by alternatives?

Requirements
  
  

**REQUIREMENTS**

Must Have

* 4–6 years in product management in travel, hospitality, fintech, or enterprise B2B SaaS
* Has conducted field discovery meetings with external ecosystem partners — not just internal user interviews
* Working knowledge of corporate travel ecosystems: TMCs, GDS platforms, OTAs, PMS providers, and how they connect
* Has shipped a B2B product that integrates with at least two external systems — understands what "integration complexity" actually means in production
* Has written PRDs that engineering shipped from without PM hand-holding in every stand-up
* Comfort with field-heavy, travel-intensive work across India

Strong Preference

* Has worked directly with Concur, SAP Concur integrations, or competing expense management platforms
* Exposure to bank lodge card progra…

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Part Of**
Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.
  
  
What you'll be responsible for
  
  
You will own product areas within Managed Payments, Circle’s regulated payments infrastructure that enables PSPs, financial institutions, banks, and enterprises to use stablecoin-powered payment rails without operating crypto infrastructure themselves. You will define and evolve product capabilities that support managed pay-ins, payouts, conversion, and transaction lifecycle management across stablecoin and fiat endpoints. Working closely with Engineering, Compliance, Operations, Treasury, and commercial teams, you will translate complex customer and business needs into clear product priorities, lead cross-functional execution, and deliver measurable improvements to how customers move money across geographies and payment rails.
  
  
What you'll work on
  
  

* Own the roadmap for product areas across managed pay-ins, payouts, fiat endpoints, conversion, and transaction lifecycle management, aligning priorities with customer needs and Circle’s goals.
* Define and launch capabilities that expand Managed Payments across Circle’s regulated hubs, including new entities, corridors, payout methods, and geographic coverage.
* Shape simple, reliable customer experiences for accepting funds, converting value, and disbursing globally across stablecoin and fiat rails, including integrations with CPN and other Circle systems.
* Improve customer and operator workflows across onboarding, account setup, transaction visibility, reporting, exception handling, reconciliation, refunds, RFIs, and bulk payments.
* Use customer, product, payment, and operational data to identify friction, prioritize investments, and measure improvements in reliability, efficiency, adoption, and customer experience.
* Evaluate opportunities to support new payment rails, payout use cases, and digital assets based on customer demand, regulatory requirements, technical feasibility, and business priorities.
* Lead complex cross-functional initiatives with Engineering, Compliance, Operations, Legal, Treasury, BD, and Product, navigating technical and business trade-offs and driving alignment from definition through launch.

What you'll bring to Circle
  
  
Core requirements
  
  

* 4+ years of relevant experience, including product management experience building payments, fintech, financial infrastructure, or similarly complex B2B products.
* Experience owning product vision, roadmaps, and execution for B2B capabilities such as payments, pay-ins, payouts, settlement, treasury infrastructure, APIs, or financial operations.
* Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex cross-functional initiatives spanning Engineering and partners such as Compliance, Operations, Legal, Treasury, or commercial teams.
* Strong analytical and technical fluency, with experience using customer, product, payment, and operational data to identify opportunities and guide product decisions.
* Track record of delivering measurable improvements to customer experience, product adoption, operational efficiency, reliability, or business performance.
* Ability to evaluate technical and business trade-offs, resolve ambiguity, and translate complex requirements into clear product priorities and execution plans.

**Preferred Requirements**

* Knowledge of cross-border payments, PSP infrastructure, settlement systems, correspondent banking, or other payment network concepts.
* Familiarity with stablecoins, blockchain-based financial infrastructure, or crypto-enabled payment systems.
* Experience with enterprise APIs, payment networks, or compliance-forward systems involving payment lifecycle states, reconciliation, exception handling, sanctions screening, RFIs, or SLAs.

Why this role matters
  
  
Managed Payments is a core part of Circle’s strategy to make stablecoin-powered payments accessible to businesses beyond crypto-native customers. Customers increasingly need complete payment programs that allow them to accept funds, manage balances, convert across assets, and disburse globally without assembling wallets, banking partners, liquidity providers, compliance systems, and payout networks themselves. As Senior Product Manager, you will help turn that complexity into an integrated customer experience and scale Managed Payments into a reliable, global, enterprise-grade product.

jobs.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in product management or related technical role.
* 3 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc.).
* Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree in a technology or business related field.
* 5 years of experience working cross-functionally with engineering, UX/UI, sales finance, and other stakeholders.
* 5 years of experience in a business function or role (e.g., strategic marketing, business operations, consulting).
* 4 years of experience in a role preparing and delivering technical presentations to senior leadership.
* 3 years of experience in software development or engineering.
* 3 years of people management experience with direct reports, and in technical leadership.

**About The Job**
At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.
  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.
  
  
Geo Makers extends Geo’s mission by empowering millions of businesses and developers with real world platforms and solutions that help people explore, navigate and get things done in the real world. We do this by exposing various APIs collectively called Google Maps Platform (GMP). The customers use us in both Business-to-Consumer (B2C) (e.g. schedule a ride, locate a store or find your next vacation) and Business-to-Business (B2B) (manage a fleet of trucks, or assess insurance risk) contexts.
  
  
The Geo team is focused on building the most accurate, comprehensive, and useful maps for our users, through products like Maps, Earth, Street View, Google Maps Platform, and more. Every month, more than a billion people rely on Maps services to explore the world and navigate their daily lives.
  
  
The Geo team also enables developers to use the power of Google Maps platforms to enhance their apps and websites. As they plot a course for the future of mapping, they are solving complex computer science problems, designing beautiful and intuitive product experiences, and improving our understanding of the real world.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Define the product goal, strategy and roadmap for the overall Map Intelligence Area, including our Maptrics platform, Insights Agents, and broader efforts supporting the emerging markets data needs.
* Provide leadership, mentorship, and cohesion across our site projects, including product efforts for India makers.
* Understand the needs of the broader Geo Makers team in order to identify and develop key insights tools and systems.
* Advocate awareness and use of Maptrics and insights both internally and externally in order to drive business success.

:**

Build the simplest, smartest way for Indians to manage their money, end to end, in one app. The modern replacement for your bank RM.

jobs.description:
**The Pitch**
-------------

As Product Owner for Workday HELP, you’ll own how our employees get answers and resolve HR issues: the cases, the knowledge, and the agents that make both smarter. You’ll implement, break things in sandbox, decide what ships, and turn Workday’s newest AI features into something employees actually use. This is a hands-on IC role. You will configure, test, and launch, not manage a backlog from a distance. And the exciting part: you will continue your consulting journey as we roll the implementation to our portfolio companies across the globe. Also, Workday is shipping AI faster than most teams can evaluate it. We want someone who gets excited about that, not overwhelmed by it.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

**Own and implement Workday HELP**

* Lead end-to-end implementation of Case Management: case categories, case types, routing, SLAs, escalation paths, security, and integrations
* Build and run Knowledge Management: article structure, authoring and approval workflows, audience targeting, and content lifecycle
* Own the HELP product roadmap, backlog, and release readiness, including triaging each Workday bi-annual release for what matters to us

**Experiment with what’s next**

* Evaluate and pilot new Workday AI capabilities as they arrive, including Illuminate and self-service agents
* Run structured experiments: define the hypothesis, configure in sandbox, test with real scenarios, and measure results
* Make clear, evidence-backed recommendations on what to adopt, defer, or skip
* Help shape our agent-led self-service approach, from deflection to guided resolution

**Make it measurable**

* Define the metrics for HR service delivery: case volume, resolution time, deflection, knowledge usage, and employee satisfaction
* Build case analytics and dashboards that show leaders what is working and where to act next

**Work across the Workday ecosystem**

* Partner with Core HCM, Talent, Recruiting, and Payroll teams so HELP works smoothly with the rest of the platform
* Work with People Operations, HR Centers of Excellence, and IT on process design, content ownership, and change management
* Coordinate with Workday and implementation partners on features, defects, and early-adopter programs

**What You Bring**
------------------

**Must-haves**

* **Hands-on Workday HELP implementation experience.** This is non-negotiable. You have taken Case Management and/or Knowledge Management from design to go-live
* **Strong Core HCM background.** You understand worker data, business processes, security, organizations, and how HELP depends on all of it
* Experience as a product owner, functional lead, or senior consultant who owns configuration, not just requirements
* Ability to translate HR service needs into clear user stories, configuration designs, and test plans
* Strong stakeholder communication across HR, IT, and business teams

**Strong plus**

* Experience implementing or piloting Workday self-service agents or Illuminate AI features
* Case management analytics experience (Workday reporting, people analytics, or dashboards on case data)

**What makes you a top candidate**

* Experience in **Peakon, Learning, or Journeys**. We want someone who sees how HELP connects to the wider employee experience, such as a Journey that triggers a case or Peakon feedback that reshapes knowledge content
* Workday certifications in HCM or related modules
* Prior experience in a shared services or global HR environment

**You’ll Thrive Here If You**
-----------------------------

* Treat every new Workday release like a gift basket and open it immediately
* Are comfortable saying “that didn’t work, here’s why, here’s what we do instead”
* Prefer building and testing over writing 40-page decks
* Care about the employee on the other end of the case, not just the configuration
* Can make a judgment call with 80% of the information

-----------------

* To bring HELP to life, hands on.
* Early access to evaluating Workday’s AI roadmap, with real influence on what we adopt

* Visible impact: every employee touches HELP
* Opportunity to grow into broader People Technology and AI-in-HR leadership as our platform scope expands
